title: CMake: Fix Windows Debug Falco library selection
description: Use debug/optimized Falco library pairs on Windows to fix Stratoshark Debug builds for #20687.

2da34553a804f7c0414df275fa65169bc008cf62 fixed the ability to build Stratoshark Debug build, but there are still warnings about finding .pdbs.  Is that what this MR is after? (Because #20687 should probably be closed now)

No, this MR was intended to address the original Stratoshark Windows Debug build failure from #20687, not the remaining `.pdb` warnings. If 2da34553 already fixed the build failure and only the warning case remains, then this MR is targeting the wrong issue. I’m happy to close it.

@@ -32,6 +32,56 @@ if( NOT USE_REPOSITORY)

+function(_sinsp_find_link_library _output_var)
+  cmake_parse_arguments(SINSP_LIB "" "" "NAMES;DEBUG_NAMES;HINTS;DEBUG_HINTS;PATHS" ${ARGN})
+
+  find_library(_sinsp_release_library NO_CACHE
+    NAMES ${SINSP_LIB_NAMES}
+    HINTS ${SINSP_LIB_HINTS}
+    PATHS ${SINSP_LIB_PATHS}
+  )
+
+  if(_sinsp_release_library)
+    set(_sinsp_link_libraries ${${_output_var}})
+    if(WIN32)
+      set(_sinsp_debug_names ${SINSP_LIB_DEBUG_NAMES})
+      if(NOT _sinsp_debug_names)
+        set(_sinsp_debug_names ${SINSP_LIB_NAMES})
+      endif()
+
+      set(_sinsp_debug_hints ${SINSP_LIB_DEBUG_HINTS})
+      if(NOT _sinsp_debug_hints)
+        set(_sinsp_debug_hints ${SINSP_LIB_HINTS})
+      endif()
+
+      find_library(_sinsp_debug_library NO_CACHE
+        NAMES ${_sinsp_debug_names}
+        HINTS ${_sinsp_debug_hints}
+        PATHS ${SINSP_LIB_PATHS}
+      )
+
+      if(_sinsp_debug_library)
+        list(APPEND _sinsp_link_libraries
+          debug ${_sinsp_debug_library}
+          optimized ${_sinsp_release_library}
+        )
+      else()
+        list(APPEND _sinsp_link_libraries ${_sinsp_release_library})
+      endif()
+
+      unset(_sinsp_debug_names)
+      unset(_sinsp_debug_hints)
+      unset(_sinsp_debug_library)
+    else()
+      list(APPEND _sinsp_link_libraries ${_sinsp_release_library})
+    endif()
+
+    set(${_output_var} ${_sinsp_link_libraries} PARENT_SCOPE)
+    unset(_sinsp_link_libraries)
+    unset(_sinsp_release_library)
+  endif()
+endfunction()
